summary: Kerb where cars park, beside a park, with houses about 20 m north.
reasons: Cars parked here, so a van blends in
Park and lawn to the west
House 9 m from the north end

drivers.seclusion: Park lawn and trees to the south-west; houses at the north end, about 20 m from the best section.
drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars show the kerb is usable; wide sealed road with room beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Local road by a school and bus stop; busier at school times.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs; signs only restrict bus and school-time stopping.

flags: Bus Zone and No Stopping 7-9am and 2-4pm on schooldays
Dwelling 9 m from the start of the kerb
sun_shade: Tree shade over the middle and south; trees to the west block afternoon sun.

best_section.where: West kerb of Carnarvon Road, south of the houses, beside the park
